fidelity: F2a — Thevenin 2-RC ECM with Coulomb-counted SOC, self-discharge, and exothermic-overcharge thermal ODE
source: Linden's Handbook of Batteries 4th ed. (2011) ch. 30-31; Bernardi & Carpenter (1995) J. Electrochem. Soc. 142(8) 2631; Khun et al. (2006) Electrochimica Acta 51 2877; Hu, Li & Peng (2012) J. Power Sources 198 359 (Thevenin ECM); Gao, Liu & Dougal (2002) IEEE Trans. Components 25(3) 495 (battery thermal); Notten & Hokkeling / Ten Haaf NiMH oxygen-recombination overcharge

unit.name: Generic NiMH AA-class cell — Thevenin 2-RC electrothermal (positive NiOOH/Ni(OH)2, negative AB5 metal hydride)

R0_ref.source: Khun et al. (2006); Linden ch. 31 NiMH impedance

R1_ref.source: Hu et al. (2012) Thevenin ECM; impedance.py style EIS fit

ocv_coefficients.note: OCV(SOC)=sum a_i*SOC^i, i=0..5. Flat ~1.2 V NiMH plateau. Reused from EC029 F1 fit.
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative NiMH discharge curve (Linden ch. 31)

E_a.note: Arrhenius activation energy for NiMH resistances (proton-conducting NiOOH kinetics)

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient; POSITIVE for NiMH (exothermic charging) unlike Li-ion

k_self_discharge.note: Self-discharge rate constant at T_ref; ~20-30%/month for NiMH (1.5e-6/s ~ 4%/month base, Arrhenius-amplified at high T)
k_self_discharge.source: Linden ch. 31; Panasonic NiMH self-discharge curves

E_a_self.note: Activation energy for self-discharge (strongly temperature accelerated)

soc_oc_onset.note: SOC at which oxygen evolution / recombination begins during charge

V_oc_threshold.note: OCV anchor near top-of-charge for overcharge logistic

f_oc_max.note: Max fraction of charge current diverted to O2 recombination at full overcharge

dH_recomb.note: Effective enthalpy voltage of O2 evolution+recombination loop (2H2O->O2+... ->2OH-); net strongly exothermic heat per recombined charge
dH_recomb.source: Notten & Hokkeling NiMH overcharge; Linden ch. 30

cp_cell.note: Lumped specific heat of NiMH cell

hA_cell.note: Cell-to-ambient heat transfer coefficient * area (natural convection)

soc0.note: Can exceed 1.0 transiently before overcharge clamps it
